veranderings.blok: Waar ons hulpbronne veral ontgin word
veranderings.rede: Standard Afrikaans says 'bekend om'; 'bekend vir' follows English 'known for'.

veranderings.na: So groei 'n klein nedersetting uit tot
veranderings.rede: 'Uitgroei tot' is the natural Afrikaans for growing into something bigger; the protected 'soms selfs tot 'n stad' stays intact.
'Uitgegroei tot' is the idiomatic form, matching the previous block.
'Om' can be misread as 'because of'; 'rondom' says clearly that the town grew around the mines.
'Versprei lê' is awkward; settlements 'are spread' over an area ('versprei is').

vlae.teks: Daarna kom huise, winkels, skole en ander dienste in die nuwe nedersetting by.
vlae.rede: 'En ander dienste' groups houses with services, which they are not; fixing it needs a content choice (for example dropping 'ander' or naming houses separately), so it is flagged rather than changed.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: One entry protects 'Emalahleni' as a video word while the 'eMalahleni (Witbank)' entry lists 'Emalahleni' under NIE; the lesson correctly uses 'eMalahleni', but a case-insensitive guard may read the two entries as conflicting.
